name: USB Audio
description: The `usb_audio` component lets an ESP32 act as a USB host for USB Audio Class (UAC) devices such as USB sound cards, USB DACs, USB microphones and USB speakerphones. A connected device can be used as a [USB Audio Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/usb_audio/), a [USB Audio Microphone](https://esphome.io/components/microphone/usb_audio/), or both. Each `usb_audio` component supports one speaker and one microphone.
